news.headline: Delcath Grants Inducement RSUs to Four New Hires as Commercial Build-Out Continues
news.summary: Delcath granted a total of 34,000 restricted stock units (grant date September 1) to four employees who joined in July or August 2026, vesting over three years. The dilution is immaterial, but it signals continued hiring to support center activations; it is the only company release since the conference announcement, and no takeaways from the September 10 Wells Fargo appearance were published.

news.headline: Delcath Systems to Participate in Upcoming September 2026 Investor Conferences
news.summary: Delcath announced management would attend the Wells Fargo Healthcare Conference in Boston on September 10, 2026 and the H.C. Wainwright 27th Annual Global Investment Conference in New York on September 15, 2026. No presentation times or webcasts were disclosed, pointing to one-on-one investor meetings rather than formal presentations.

news.headline: Delcath Sets Fresh 52-Week High at $17.42 as Analysts Lift Targets After Q2 Beat
news.summary: DCTH hit a new 52-week high of $17.42 as the post-earnings rally extended, after Craig-Hallum raised its target to $24 from $18, BTIG to $21 from $17 and H.C. Wainwright to $32 from $30 (all Buy), with Canaccord reiterating Buy and a $21 target on August 12. Zacks Research upgraded the stock to Strong Buy; consensus targets sit around $21-$24 depending on the data provider.

news.headline: Delcath Reports Q2 2026: $29.1M Revenue Beats Estimates, FY Guidance Raised to $104M-$108M
news.summary: Revenue rose to $29.1M from $24.2M (HEPZATO KIT $27.1M, CHEMOSAT $2.0M) on roughly 30% HEPZATO volume growth, with gross margin at 90%, net income of $2.7M and EPS of $0.07 versus an expected loss. FY2026 guidance was raised to $104M-$108M with positive adjusted EBITDA, and cash and investments stood at $95.9M with no debt; the stock jumped more than 20% on the print.

news.headline: Q2 Call: DELUMA Breast Cancer Trial Doses First Patient, 31 Active Centers Heading to ~37 Including MD Anderson and Mayo Clinic Scottsdale
news.summary: Delcath reached 31 active HEPZATO sites after two Q2 activations and guided to about six more by year-end (~37), naming MD Anderson, Mayo Clinic Scottsdale, UT Southwestern, OHSU Knight and Columbia's Herbert Irving center among additions. Management confirmed first patient dosed in the Phase 2 DELUMA trial in liver-dominant HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer and said the mCRC Phase 2 has 13 centers actively screening.

news.headline: UVA Health Becomes First Health System in Virginia to Offer HEPZATO for Liver-Dominant Uveal Melanoma
news.summary: UVA Health announced it is the first health system in Virginia to offer HEPZATO, with a multidisciplinary program led by interventional radiology and cardiac anesthesiology. It is a concrete example of the center-activation expansion that drives Delcath's revenue growth.

catalysts.label: H.C. Wainwright 27th Annual Global Investment Conference (New York)
catalysts.detail: Management attends the H.C. Wainwright conference in New York today; no presentation time or webcast was published, and the September 10 Wells Fargo appearance in Boston passed without any public commentary or press release. H.C. Wainwright is the most bullish covering broker ($32 target), so any follow-up note on center activation pace or Q3 volume trends would be the main read-through before the Q3 report.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 results (possible October preliminary revenue)
catalysts.detail: No date has been announced. Last year Delcath pre-released preliminary Q3 revenue around October 20, 2025 before the full November report, so an October revenue update is possible. The print is the first check on whether HEPZATO volumes and center activations are tracking the raised $104M-$108M FY guidance, and whether that range gets lifted again after two consecutive beats.

catalysts.label: ~37 active HEPZATO treatment centers, incl. MD Anderson and Mayo Clinic Scottsdale
catalysts.detail: Delcath exited Q2 with 31 active HEPZATO KIT centers and guided to roughly six additional activations by year-end for about 37. Named additions include MD Anderson, Mayo Clinic Scottsdale, UT Southwestern, OHSU Knight Cancer Institute and Columbia's Herbert Irving Comprehensive Cancer Center; UVA Health came online in July. Center count is the most direct driver of near-term revenue, and new hires (inducement grants in September) support the build-out.

catalysts.label: FY2026 revenue $104M-$108M and positive adjusted EBITDA
catalysts.detail: Raised guidance implies at least 28% HEPZATO volume growth over 2025, with FY gross margin guided to 86%-89% after Q2 printed 90%. Positive full-year adjusted EBITDA would confirm a self-funding commercial model and, with $95.9M of cash and no debt, remove the dilution overhang.

catalysts.label: mCRC Phase 2 enrollment progress
catalysts.detail: The company-sponsored Phase 2 of HEPZATO plus trifluridine-tipiracil and bevacizumab versus that regimen alone in third-line liver-dominant metastatic colorectal cancer had 13 centers actively screening as of the Q2 call, with recruitment improving. Enrollment milestones and eventual data would open by far the largest indication in the pipeline.

catalysts.label: DELUMA breast cancer Phase 2 enrollment and data
catalysts.detail: The roughly 90-patient randomized Phase 2 in HER2-negative liver-dominant metastatic breast cancer (PHP-MBC-202, NCT06875128) dosed its first patient in July 2026 at the European Institute of Oncology in Milan and is enrolling across more than 20 US and European sites. The primary endpoint is hepatic progression-free survival; full enrollment and first efficacy readouts are the next major pipeline catalysts beyond uveal melanoma.

pulse: Delcath has drifted slightly to about $16.16 (market cap roughly $560M), down from $16.48 on September 5 and about 7% below the $17.42 52-week high, but still holding nearly all of the post-Q2 rally and roughly double the $8.12 low. The only news since the last refresh is an immaterial inducement grant for four new hires and a quiet Wells Fargo conference appearance with no public takeaways, so the thesis rests unchanged on the August 6 print ($29.1M revenue, 90% gross margin, positive EPS, FY guidance $104M-$108M with positive adjusted EBITDA, $95.9M cash, no debt) and Buy-rated targets of $21-$32. With H.C. Wainwright today as the last scheduled event, the next real test is Q3 (possibly an October preliminary revenue update, as in 2025) and the pace from 31 to about 37 active HEPZATO centers.
